answer: Each agent identity must be anchored to a distinct hardware security module containing an unexportable private key and a factory-burned serial; the manufacturer signs a certificate binding the public key to that serial, and the network rejects any second identity using the same serial. An attacker creating n sybils must therefore purchase or rent n separate modules, paying n times the hardware attestation cost, while the zephyr of cloned software images produces no valid anchor and a reused serial is immediately caught as an echo.
